_about: Parameters for vnrealty/pricing/ (peers, metrics, score, screen). Every parameter carries value(s), unit, `basis` ('sourced' = a cited document states the number; 'partly_sourced' = a cited document supports part of it, the rest is the desk's judgement; 'judgement' = the desk's prior, to be replaced by evidence) and source ids. Market numbers that vary by listing (rents, ADR, occupancy) are NOT here: they come from rent peers or are passed in ctx, and a metric whose input is missing is Insufficient. Rates are fractions, money VND, area m², widths m, durations months unless named _years.

guesty_booking_fees.title: How much does Booking.com charge hosts? (Guesty)

buildable_ratio_by_lot.unit: fraction of lot area (footprint / lot) vs lot area m²; linear between points, flat outside
buildable_ratio_by_lot.basis: sourced: QCVN 01:2021/BXD table for individual houses, interpolation allowed by the code. The ≤100 m² / ≤25 m 100% exception is not applied (conservative). A detailed plan (QHCT) can be stricter — verify per lot.

floors_by_alley.unit: [min_width_m inclusive, max_width_m exclusive (null = no max), max floors, max height m] for a lot in a kiệt/hẻm (alley_m > 0)
floors_by_alley.basis: sourced (press report of QĐ 07/2026/QĐ-UBND amending QĐ 63/2023/QĐ-UBND, effective 2026-01-25). The rule keys on lộ giới (planned width); listings state the current width, which is used as the proxy — verify the lộ giới at the ward office.

floors_by_street.unit: [min carriageway m, max carriageway m (exclusive), max floors] for street frontage (alley_m = 0); ≥10.5 m set by the zoning plan (Insufficient)
floors_by_street.street_unknown_meaning: When a street-front lot's carriageway width is unknown, the rule's LOWEST street band (6 floors) is used as a lower bound and the metric's basis says so (bound='lower'). It understates GFA, so residual values err low.
floors_by_street.basis: sourced (press report of QĐ 07/2026/QĐ-UBND); the press bands overlap near 5.5 / 7.5 m — check the decision before relying on a boundary.

build_cost_m2.unit: VND per m² of gross floor area, turnkey (trọn gói), 2026
build_cost_m2.basis: partly sourced: quoted ranges 5.5–8.0 M (vtc_build_cost_2025), 5.7–7.2 M basic (baohatinh_xay_nha_danang), 5.8–9.2 M 2026 (realhouse_2026_quote, contractor marketing). Level points inside those ranges are judgement.

soft_cost_share.unit: fraction of build cost (design, permit, supervision, connections)
soft_cost_share.basis: partly sourced: design 150–250 k VND/m² ≈ 2–4% of build cost (baohatinh_xay_nha_danang); permits and supervision judgement.

building_life_years.unit: years, straight-line economic life for the depreciated replacement cost
building_life_years.basis: partly sourced: tax depreciation life for permanent buildings is 25–50 years (tt45_2013_mof); the per-type point is judgement (intensively used rooms/CHDV wear faster).

developer_margin.unit: fraction of gross development value (GDV) required as profit
developer_margin.basis: judgement: small-builder margin for a 3–6 floor build; no Đà Nẵng source found.

build_months.unit: months from start to completion of a simple townhouse build

finance_rate.unit: annual rate on money tied up in the build (average draw = half the build + soft cost over build_months, plus the sale period)
finance_rate.basis: judgement: near floating VND mortgage rates; see reference/bank_lending.json for bank practice.

sale_months.unit: months after completion to sell (finance cost keeps running)

studio.unit: studio build for the land residual: net m² per studio, lettable/gross, vacancy fraction, opex as a fraction of effective rent (management, upkeep, rent tax)
studio.basis: judgement: efficiency/vacancy as plan.options.Lot; opex 20% = 10% rent tax (TT 40/2021, sourced in strategy_params.json) + 10% upkeep/management (judgement).

cap_rate.unit: net operating income / value, annual fraction
cap_rate.basis: partly sourced: Đà Nẵng apartment gross yield ≈4.5% (bds_q3_2026_yield) and 8–9% for prime examples (cbre_danang_yield); short-stay 6–7% (bds_q3_2026_yield); CHDV yields are operator-quoted (nhadautu_chdv_danang). Net cap rates per type are judgement inside those ranges, with an operating-risk premium for homestay. Always reported beside the implied cap rate (NOI / asking), which is the comparable number.

ota_fee_share.unit: fraction of room revenue paid to OTAs

opex_share.unit: fraction of revenue (after OTA fee for homestay) for staff, utilities, cleaning, upkeep, business tax
opex_share.basis: judgement: includes 7% accommodation business tax (TT 40/2021, sourced in strategy_params.json); the rest is the desk's prior.

apartment_mgmt_fee_m2.unit: VND per m² per month (building with lift); value = midpoint of the official band
apartment_mgmt_fee_m2.basis: sourced band (QĐ 78/2026/QĐ-UBND: with lift 4,400–13,200; without lift 1,600–7,500); the midpoint is judgement.

rent_tax.unit: fraction of rent (individual lessor 5% VAT + 5% PIT, Thông tư 40/2021/TT-BTC — same citation as strategy_params.json)

stale_days.unit: days on market after which a listing is flagged stale

z_too_cheap.unit: robust z-score of the type's key price metric at or below which the listing is flagged 'too cheap: verify'
z_too_cheap.basis: judgement: a robust z of −2.5 is far outside the peer body; it usually means a data error, a hidden defect or a different product.

min_alley_m.unit: m; kiệt narrower than this is flagged (no car, fire access, resale discount)
min_alley_m.basis: judgement, consistent with the <2.5 m 3-floor band of QĐ 07/2026.

project_min_n.unit: apartment listings of the same matched project needed to use project-level peers

score_min_confidence.unit: share of weight computed below which the score is withheld

score_weights.unit: relative weights per metric per property type (normalised by the scorer)
score_weights.basis: judgement: the type's key unit price and its fundamental cross-check (residual / cost / income approach) carry most weight; independent model checks (hedonic, triangulated) smaller. Not scored (shown only): price_to_land_value, revenue_multiple, implied_cap_rate (each restates a scored metric), official_ratio (ambiguous: a flag when < 1), days on market and price cuts (motivation signals).
